dialogue_texts: Impressive... Your amulets pierce through the parallel paths far better than I anticipated.
It seems the Hakurei Shrine Maiden's reputation isn't just for show.
The boundaries of this manor are completely warped, and Koko was carrying an amulet that wasn't hers.
What are you actually trying to achieve here?
I have no desire to destroy this reality. In fact, I am trying to anchor it.
This manor is caught in a temporal drift, bleeding into multiple timelines at once.
That explains why the spiritual layout feels familiar yet entirely alien.
But why use Koko to block the paths?
To keep the glohm from collapsing inward before the core is stabilized.
If you truly possess the strength to shatter my axes...
Perhaps you can force your way to the center of the anomaly.
We were going to do that anyway. We're on our way to the Shirogane Manor, so don't get in our way again.
